name: plugin.vibe_scanner
description: Static AST security scanner detecting AI-generated code vulnerabilities, secrets, SQL injection, path traversal, weak crypto, and anti-patterns

entrypoints.name: scan_code
entrypoints.description: Scan in-memory Python source code string for 7 AI security vulnerability classes with line numbers and fix hints

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Python source code string to analyze

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: Optional synthetic file name for context reporting

entrypoints.name: scan_file
entrypoints.description: Scan a single Python source file on disk for AST security vulnerabilities

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the Python file to analyze

entrypoints.name: scan_project
entrypoints.description: Recursively scan a project directory of Python files, skipping virtual environments and caches

parameters.name: ignore_dirs
parameters.description: Optional list of directory names to ignore during traversal

parameters.name: fail_on_critical
parameters.description: Whether to mark scan status as failed if any critical severity issues exist

entrypoints.name: compare_benchmark
entrypoints.description: Compare vulnerable code against remediated/secure code to verify risk reduction and fix efficacy

parameters.name: vulnerable_code
parameters.description: Source code prior to security remediation

parameters.name: secure_code
parameters.description: Remediated source code after applying fix hints

entrypoints.name: generate_sarif_report
entrypoints.description: Scan a project directory and export a standard SARIF v2.1.0 security report for GitHub Security integration

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Target file path to write the SARIF JSON output

entrypoints.name: generate_json_report
entrypoints.description: Scan a project directory and export a structured JSON security findings report

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Target file path to write the JSON output
